summary: The dependency list of `useEffect`, `useMemo`, `useCallback` and friends names every value from the component that the callback reads.
why: A missing dependency leaves the callback holding the value from an earlier render. Nothing crashes; the screen just shows stale data.
note: When an effect should not re-run for a value, move that value out of the component or read it through a ref, instead of leaving it out of the list.
